notes.title: Version 1.3.1 - Finally a Fix for Xbox controllers
notes.content:
It seems that somewhere along the line the key configurations of Xbox controllers got messed up. I looked deep into the controller code and found the issue. This fix should make it finally possible to enjoy the game with the magnificent Xbox controllers. Thank you to everyone who reported this issue.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 Released. Fixes for Controller issues.
notes.content:
A few users reported that they were having issues with Xbox and other controllers being detected in the game. This release should fix many of the controller customization errors. All users who had issues with controller detection or controller customization are advised to update and reconfigure controller buttons.

If there area still issues after re-configuring controller keys I advise you to restart the game. Some times the new mappings are not used when in game as the main controller detection is done in game start.

Thank you and happy gaming!
